title: UAAP: NU must guard against complacency, says Paul Francisco

blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—National University veteran Paul Francisco was quick to point out the Bulldogs’ biggest flaw in their loss to Ateneo in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament. Following NU’s 87-76 loss to the Blue Eagles, Francisco admitted that the Bulldogs became complacent after their red-hot start. “We never underestimate our opponents. What killed us was us being too relaxed with our first quarter lead,” Francisco told the Inquirer at Philsports Arena on Saturday. “We became too relaxed and complacent with how we started. We have to finish the job better.” […]... Keep on reading: UAAP: NU must guard against complacency, says Paul Francisco
